extraction.Name: Rena Whiting, formerly Rena Giroux
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded May 25, 1920 by Fred C. Jenkins
extraction.Buyer: Rena Whiting and Ed. L. Whiting, Jr. conveyed the land, by deed to Fred C. Jenkins for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739703 issued; Southwest quarter section 33, township 37, north of range 25; receipt for patent signed by the allottee on April 2, 1920; conveyance dated May 18, 1920
